notes: Database Integrity Guard. Follows a full Cloud Master cleanup protected by an 811-record pre-cleanup snapshot. Adds a local integrity monitor for duplicate Product identities, exact duplicate inventory, orphan inventory links, and stock-program unit/placeholders. Warehouse Voice now counts only confirmed, identity-compatible inventory for strict Roll stock programs such as Platinum, Heather Choice and Spill Blocker, and excludes stale zero-quantity physical-count placeholders when confirmed stock exists. The cleanup also standardizes the Product Master title TAKTIK-3GAL, preserves historical operation snapshots, retires legacy duplicate/stale records with tombstones, and keeps Cloud Master as the source of truth.
